reuse.why: Puts the new rule inside the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper that getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and the budget schedule template already share, and passes frequency through parseRecurDate.

duplication.why: The daily-skip decision exists once; the schedule-template's two copied adjust ternaries are folded into a local getOccurrenceDay, though each caller still needs its own null handling and over-fetch (DAILY_CYCLE_LENGTH) logic.

placement.why: The weekend rule stays in shared/schedules where weekend adjustment already lives; callers only pass their schedule's frequency.

scope.why: Only the weekend rule, its plumbing and targeted tests.

maintainability.why: One definition of the rule is easy to change, but turning getDateWithSkippedWeekend into a nullable return means every caller must remember to filter nulls and over-fetch occurrences, which is spread across three files.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All three weekend-adjusting paths call getDateWithSkippedWeekend with the frequency.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the schedule-template's repeated ternary is replaced by one helper call.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getDateWithSkippedWeekend returns null for daily weekend occurrences; getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList all use it.
